subject: Sam Bankman-Fried
query: is sam bankman-fried still in prison
title: Is Sam Bankman-Fried still in prison? Yes, and his appeal failed
answer: Yes. The FTX founder is serving a 25-year federal sentence after a jury convicted him of fraud and conspiracy in November 2023. A federal appeals court upheld the conviction and sentence on June 12, 2026, and he is eligible for release in 2044.
body:
Sam Bankman-Fried, often called SBF, founded the crypto exchange FTX, which collapsed in November 2022. Prosecutors said he took about $8 billion in customer money to cover losses at his trading firm, Alameda Research, and to fund investments, political donations and real estate. A Manhattan jury found him guilty on all seven counts on Nov. 2, 2023, including wire fraud and conspiracy. On March 28, 2024, U.S. District Judge Lewis Kaplan sentenced him to 25 years in prison; prosecutors had asked for 40 to 50.

His appeal failed. On June 12, 2026, a unanimous three-judge panel of the 2nd U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals rejected his argument that Kaplan wrongly kept out evidence that FTX had enough money to repay customers. The court said the evidence against him was robust and that taking money by deception is fraud even if the defendant hopes to pay it back. Al Jazeera reported that he is held in a low-security federal prison in California.

He is still trying to get out early. According to Parade, his lawyers are pursuing a U.S. Supreme Court petition and challenging the roughly $11 billion forfeiture order, and he has asked President Trump for a pardon, which he himself has called "an uphill battle." No pardon had been granted as of Nov. 22, 2026.

He is about to be back in the spotlight. Prime Video's docuseries "The Boy Who Stole Billions?" premieres Nov. 30, 2026, and features interviews Bankman-Fried gave from prison, telling his side of the FTX story.
